summary: A cleaned CSV of active US federal trademark registrations sourced from USPTO bulk data files — publicly downloadable from the USPTO Open Data Portal without authentication. Each record includes the registrant/owner name, city, state, mark type (standard character, stylized, design), goods and services description, International Class codes, filing date, registration date, attorney of record, and current status (live/registered). Corsearch and TrademarkNow charge $5,000–$15,000+/year for trademark monitoring and analytics built on this exact public data. CompuMark trademark reports run $50–$200 per search. A $49 one-time flat file on Gumroad targets IP law firms prospecting for trademark clients, domain registrars and brand protection companies identifying mark holders, and B2B SaaS vendors targeting brand-active companies — all of whom need a bulk trademark registrant list that no affordable flat-file product currently sells.

audience.who: IP law firms and solo trademark attorneys who need a list of recently registered trademark owners (by state or class) to cold-outreach for office action responses, renewal reminders, and prosecution engagements; domain registrar and brand protection companies (MarkMonitor, CSC) identifying companies with active trademarks as prospects for domain monitoring services; B2B SaaS companies targeting brand-active mid-market companies (e.g., e-commerce brands, consumer goods companies) for whom trademark filings are a reliable proxy for brand investment and growth stage; business brokers and M&A advisers assessing IP portfolio value during due diligence.

data_wanted: USPTO Trademark bulk data — flat file ZIPs available from the USPTO Open Data Portal at https://data.uspto.gov/bulkdata without login. Specifically: daily trademark application XML files (full text, no images) at https://data.uspto.gov/bulkdata/datasets/trtdxfap and the annual backfile. Key fields per mark: serial number, registration number, word mark / mark literal element, filing date, registration date, owner / registrant name, owner entity type (individual, corporation, LLC), owner city, state, country, goods and services description, International Class codes (ICG), current status code (live registered vs. abandoned), attorney of record name and firm, opposition period flag. Scope to live/registered marks with US owner addresses for a commercially actionable CSV. Approximately 2.5–3M live registered marks on the federal register.

willingness_to_pay.signal: The trademark intelligence market has strong enterprise demand: Corsearch runs $5K–$15K/year, TrademarkNow (Clarivate) and Dennemeyer charge similarly, and solo trademark attorneys routinely pay $75–$200 per CompuMark search report. The key insight is that no flat-file product targeting the bottom of the market exists — every product is either a per-search tool or an enterprise subscription. A $49 CSV of active registrants filtered by US state and International Class is a completely new price point for the market. IP attorneys prospecting for new clients are the highest-conviction buyer: identifying every registrant in their specialty class (e.g., Class 25 fashion brands, Class 9 software) in their state is worth one consultation fee ($250–$500).

first_sale_path.channel: Gumroad one-time download + LinkedIn posts targeting IP attorneys, brand managers, and domain/brand protection professionals + r/trademark and r/smallbusiness subreddit contextual posts + direct LinkedIn outreach to solo IP attorneys and boutique trademark law firm partners
first_sale_path.angle: Title: 'US Federal Trademark Database 2026 — 2.5M+ Active Registered Marks with Owner, Class, Registration Date (CSV)'. Key selling points: (1) Every live registered US federal trademark — owner name, city, state, International Class, goods/services description, attorney of record, (2) Direct from USPTO bulk data — public domain, same source as Corsearch and TrademarkNow, (3) Filter by state and International Class — find every Class 25 (fashion) trademark owner in California or every Class 9 (software) registrant in Texas, (4) One-time $49 flat file — no $5K/year subscription. IP attorney angle: 'Find your next trademark client — every registrant in your specialty class in your state. $49 once. Instant CSV.'
